It allows members to browse the profiles of any other members, [ 2 ] and share tags and virtual gifts. Tagged claims it has 300 million members as of 2014. [ 3 ] As of September 2011, Quantcast estimates Tagged monthly unique users at 5.9 million in the United States, and 18.6 million globally.
